lane: Elevation Campaign v2.1, Stream γ (PŪRṆA), Lane K2 · EL-09
purpose:
~20 core classical Jyotish attributions, checked over served prose. Bounded to the
    ELEVATION_REGISTER's own documented instances (EL-09: Sun/Moon karakatva swap, Sade-Sati
    phase inversion, 9th-house over-read, lay house-glosses) plus well-known classical
    misattribution classes of comparable severity — NOT an exhaustive dogmatics table. Each entry
    is checked by evals/k2/classical_attribution_checker.ts, a pattern-style scan over served
    prose (not a chart-fact verifier — this table is about CLASSICAL CORRECTNESS of general
    astrological claims, independent of any specific chart).

entries.claim_family: naisargika karaka — Sun vs Moon
entries.correct_attribution: Sun = naisargika ātmakāraka (soul/self-significator). Moon = manas karaka (mind, emotions, mother) — NOT the soul.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ch.3, naisargika (natural) karaka scheme.
entries.note: This is EL-09's own cited instance (S1-06, S2-03: 'Moon repeatedly called soul-indicator').

entries.claim_family: Jupiter karakatva — wisdom/dharma, not direct wealth
entries.correct_attribution: Jupiter is karaka for jñāna/dharma/guru (wisdom, higher learning, dharma) and putra (children) — not the direct/primary dhana (wealth) karaka. Wealth is governed by the 2nd/11th-lord combinations (dhana yogas), not by Jupiter's naisargika karakatva.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ch.3; dhana yoga doctrine is bhāva-lord (house-lord) based, not naisargika-karaka based.
entries.note: Charter's own cited example (ELEVATION_CAMPAIGN_CHARTER_v2_1.md §γ.K2: 'Jupiter = guru/wisdom not wealth directly').

entries.claim_family: Mars karakatva — siblings/courage, not general marriage
entries.correct_attribution: Mars is karaka for bhrātṛ (siblings), parākrama (courage/valor), and land; it is NOT the general karaka for marriage. Mars's marital relevance is specific to Kuja/Maṅgal Doṣa affliction (see ATTR-19), not general marriage karakatva — that role belongs to Venus / the 7th lord / Jupiter (for a female native).
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ch.3 naisargika karakas; Kuja Doṣa as a distinct, bounded doctrine.

entries.claim_family: Mercury karakatva — speech/intellect, not siblings
entries.correct_attribution: Mercury is karaka for vidyā/buddhi (speech, intellect, commerce) — the karaka for siblings is Mars, not Mercury.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ch.3.

entries.claim_family: Venus karakatva — spouse/bhoga, not "the wealth planet"
entries.correct_attribution: Venus is karaka for kalātra (spouse, for a male native primarily) and bhoga (comforts, luxury, vehicles, arts) — not interchangeable with 'the wealth planet.' Dhana yogas are 2nd/11th-lord combinations; Venus's link to material life is via bhoga/enjoyment, not direct dhana karakatva.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ch.3.

entries.claim_family: Saturn — not a uniform malefic
entries.correct_attribution: Saturn well-placed (e.g. exalted/own-sign in a kendra, forming Śaśa Yoga — one of the Pañca Mahāpuruṣa Yogas) confers status, discipline, and durable material gains. Treating Saturn as uniformly malefic ignores this well-established classical exception.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Pañca Mahāpuruṣa Yoga doctrine (Śaśa Yoga).

entries.claim_family: 3rd house — parākrama, not siblings-only
entries.correct_attribution: The 3rd house's classical core signification is parākrama (courage, self-effort, valor) — siblings (specifically younger siblings) is ONE signification among several (short journeys, communication, skill/display), not the whole house. Reducing it to 'siblings' under-reads it.
entries.classical_basis: Classical bhāva doctrine (BPHS bhāva chapters).
entries.note: Cited by the charter as a 'lay gloss' pattern (ELEVATION_REGISTER_v1_0.md EL-09).

entries.claim_family: 9th house — bhāgya, not literal "income channel"
entries.correct_attribution: The 9th house governs bhāgya (fortune), dharma, father, guru, and long journeys/pilgrimage — it is NOT a direct 'income channel.' Income streams are governed primarily by the 2nd house (accumulated wealth) and 11th house (gains), with the 10th for profession-derived income; the 9th's link to prosperity is via bhāgya (fortune), not literal cash flow.
entries.classical_basis: Classical bhāva doctrine.
entries.note: EL-09's own cited instance: '9th-house income channel over-read (S1-01)'.

entries.claim_family: Kemadruma Yoga cancellation conditions
entries.correct_attribution: Kemadruma Yoga cancellation requires SPECIFIC conditions: planets in kendra from the Moon or Lagna that are not debilitated/combust, OR the Moon itself forming Sunāpha/Anāpha/Durudharā (occupied 2nd and/or 12th from Moon) — not cancellation by the generic presence of 'some other planet in the chart.'
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Kemadruma Yoga chapter + Sunāpha/Anāpha/Durudharā doctrine.
entries.note: The native chart's own reading-notes get this right: 'Anapha Yoga genuinely fires ... Kemadruma is FALSE' (reading_notes_get, CR-80) — the wrong-pattern here targets a LOOSER, unsupported cancellation claim.

entries.claim_family: Sade-Sati phase structure — the peak is NOT easing
entries.correct_attribution: Sade-Sati's three phases are: rising (Saturn transiting the 12th-from-Moon), PEAK (Saturn transiting the natal Moon sign / Janma Rāśi — maximum intensity), and setting (Saturn transiting the 2nd-from-Moon). The peak phase is the period of MAXIMUM intensity, never 'tail' or 'easing' — calling it that inverts the classical structure.
entries.classical_basis: Classical Sade-Sati (Śani-Sāḍesātī) transit doctrine.
entries.note: EL-09's own cited instance, S4-06: 'Sade-Sati 2023 called tail/easing when it was Janma-Shani peak.'

entries.claim_family: Rahu/Ketu — chāyā graha, not Parāśari sign-lords
entries.correct_attribution: Rahu and Ketu are chāyā grahas (shadow points / lunar nodes), not physical grahas with their own rāśi rulership in the baseline Parāśari system. 'Rahu rules Aquarius' / 'Ketu rules Scorpio' is a Jaimini/alternate-system claim (co-lordship), not a Parāśari-system fact — it should be labelled as such, not stated as flat baseline fact.
entries.classical_basis: Parāśari vs Jaimini system distinction; BPHS graha chapters (7 classical grahas own the 12 signs) vs Jaimini co-lordship convention.

entries.claim_family: Ketu — not purely malefic
entries.correct_attribution: Ketu is karaka for mokṣa (liberation), vairāgya (detachment), and past-life karma — traditionally described as sharing qualities with Jupiter ('headless Jupiter,' per the Puranic Samudra-Manthan imagery). Reducing Ketu to 'just a malefic' drops its spiritual karakatva entirely.
entries.classical_basis: Traditional Jyotish commentary on the chāyā grahas' spiritual significations.

entries.claim_family: Neecha-Bhaṅga (debilitation-cancellation) requires specific conditions
entries.correct_attribution: Neecha-Bhaṅga (debilitation-cancellation) requires SPECIFIC classical conditions — e.g. the dispositor of the debilitated planet's sign is in a kendra from Lagna/Moon, or the debilitated planet's exaltation-lord is likewise well-placed — not simple 'aspected by any benefic.'
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Neecha-Bhaṅga Rāja Yoga chapter.
entries.note: The native chart's own reading-notes correctly ground this: 'both debilities carry NBRY grounds' (CR-71) — the wrong-pattern targets the looser, unsupported claim.

entries.claim_family: Daśā system must be named, not generic
entries.correct_attribution: Every daśā (mahādaśā/bhukti) claim must name WHICH system produced it (Vimśottarī, Yogini, Chara, Aṣṭottarī, etc.) — Vimśottarī is the default in most modern practice but is not the only system, and presenting a result as generic unnamed "your dasha" is a precision-class error (conflating systems, or hiding which one is actually in play).
entries.classical_basis: Multiple parallel daśā systems coexist classically (BPHS + Jaimini + regional traditions); DR-14 in this codebase already tracks 'dasha systems beyond Vimśottarī.'

entries.claim_family: Arudha Lagna — perception, not literal circumstance
entries.correct_attribution: Arudha Lagna (AL) reflects how the native's material circumstances APPEAR to others (perception/public image) — the literal, actual circumstances are the Lagna's domain. Treating Arudha Lagna results as literal fact rather than 'perceived image' misapplies Jaimini theory.
entries.classical_basis: Jaimini Sūtras, Arudha Pada doctrine.

entries.claim_family: Ashtakavarga bindus — a strength overlay, not a standalone yoga
entries.correct_attribution: Ashtakavarga bindus are a STRENGTH-modifying overlay used to assess transit/daśā results against an existing rāśi/graha-based structure — they do not, by themselves, form a 'yoga.' A bindu count alone (e.g. '8 bindus in the 2nd house') is not a substitute for an actual rāśi-chart or varga-chart yoga.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters — an auxiliary strength system, not a yoga-forming mechanism.

entries.claim_family: Combustion (astāṅgata) — planet-specific orbs, not a uniform threshold
entries.correct_attribution: Classical combustion (astāṅgata) orb thresholds are PLANET-SPECIFIC, not a single uniform degree value across all grahas — approximate classical figures (sources vary slightly): Moon ~12°, Mars ~17°, Mercury ~14° (tighter, ~12°, retrograde), Jupiter ~11°, Venus ~10° (tighter, ~8°, retrograde), Saturn ~15°. Treating 'close to the Sun' as one fixed threshold for every planet is a precision-class error.
entries.classical_basis: Classical astāṅgata (combustion) tables; exact orb values vary slightly by source text.

entries.claim_family: Vargottama — specifically the D1↔D9 relationship
entries.correct_attribution: Vargottama specifically refers to a planet or lagna occupying the SAME sign in both D1 (rāśi) and D9 (navāṁśa) — not the same sign repeating across any two arbitrary divisional charts. Calling a planet 'vargottama' for repeating a sign in, say, D1 and D10, misapplies the term.
entries.classical_basis: Classical varga doctrine; navāṁśa (D9) is the chart vargottama is specifically defined against.

entries.claim_family: Kuja/Maṅgal Doṣa — house-and-aspect specific, not "Mars anywhere"
entries.correct_attribution: Kuja/Maṅgal Doṣa is HOUSE-AND-ASPECT specific — classically assessed from Mars's placement in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house from Lagna (and, in several regional traditions, cross-checked from the Moon and Venus too), not 'Mars anywhere in the chart.'
entries.classical_basis: Classical Kuja Doṣa doctrine (house-specific formulation; regional traditions add Moon/Venus cross-checks).

entries.claim_family: Gaja-Kesari Yoga — Jupiter in KENDRA from Moon, not just "strong" or loosely related
entries.correct_attribution: Gaja-Kesari Yoga classically forms when Jupiter occupies a KENDRA (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon — not merely whenever 'Moon and Jupiter are both strong' or vaguely well-disposed. Conjunction (kendra distance zero) is the most cited case but not the only qualifying kendra relationship.
entries.classical_basis: BPHS Gaja-Kesari Yoga definition (kendra from Moon).
